paite: Huan naupang Samuel in Eli ma ah TOUPA nna asem hi. Huai lai in TOUPA thu tung avang mahmah a; alangtang a kilaknate a-om kei hi.
heading: Samuel Kiang Ah TOUPA Kilak

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai in, Eli amun a alup lai in, amit amial panta a, khua agina muhthei nawn ngel kei hi.
Pathian khawnvak amih ma in, Pathian bawm omna TOUPA tempul ah Samuel ihmu ding in alumta hi.
"TOUPA'N Samuel asam a," ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om,” achi hi.
Eli kiang ah ava tai a, akiang ah, "Hiai ah ka om, na hon sam a,” achi hi. Ama'n, "K'on sam kei; va lum nawn in," achi hi. Huchi in apai a, ava lum nawn hi.
TOUPA'N Samuel asam nawn hi. Samuel athou a, Eli kiang ah ahoh a, "Hiai ah ka om, na hon sam a,” achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "K'on sam kei, ka tapa, va lum nawn in,” achi hi.
Huai lai in Samuel in TOUPA athei nai kei a, TOUPA thu leng akiang a kilaksak ahi nai kei hi.
TOUPA'N Samuel asam nawn a, huai athumveina ahita. Amah athou a, Eli kiang ah ahoh a, "Hiai ah ka om, na hon sam a," achi hi. Huchi in Eli in naupang TOUPA'N sam ahi chih atheita hi.
Huaiziak in Eli in Samuel kiang ah, "Pai inla, va lum nawn inla, ahon sap nawnleh, TOUPA, thu gen in, na sikha in angaikhia, na chi ding," achi hi. Huchi in Samuel apaita a, amun ah ava lum nawn hi.
TOUPA ahong pai a, hong dingh in, ama a asap bang in, "Samuel, Samuel," achi hi. Huchi in Samuel in, "Thu gen in, na sikha in angaikhia hi," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Samuel kiang ah, "Ngai in, Israel gam ah aza peuhmahte bil langnih a aphuaitak in thil khat ka hih ding hi.
Huai ni in a-inkuan tungtang thu ka gen tengteng abul a pan atawp tan in Eli tung ah ka hih ding ahi.
Atapate'n Pathian agensiatna khelhna uh theigige napi a, akham louh ziak in a-inkuan tangtawn a ding in ka hawmsak ding hi, chih ka hilh khinta ngal a.
Huaiziak in Eli inkuan kiang ah Eli inkuan bohsiatna kithoihna in hiam, thillat in hiam, chikchiang in leng siansak theih ahi kei ding, chi in ka kichiam khinta hi," achi hi.
Zingsang tan in Samuel alum a, TOUPA' inn kongkhakte ahong hi. Samuel in huai kilakna Eli theihsak alau hi.
Huchi in Eli in Samuel asam a, "Samuel, ka tapa," achi hi. Ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi hi.

Ama'n, "Bang thil ahia TOUPA'N na kiang a agen? Ka kiang ah bangmah iim ke'n aw. Na kiang a agen tengteng ka kiang a iim na neihleh na tung ah Pathian in ahihhih in hih henla, huai sang a thupizaw in leng," achi hi.
Samuel in thil tengteng ahilh sipsip a, akiang ah bangmah iim anei kei. Huchi in ama'n, "TOUPA thuthu ahi mah ve, hoih asak bang in hih hen aw," achi hi.
Samuel ahong khanglian deuhdeuh a, akiang ah TOUPA a-om a, athu himhim lei lak ah akesak kei hi.
Huchi in Dan a pan Beer-sheba tan in Israel mi tengteng in TOUPA zawlnei dia Samuel hihkip ahi, chih ana theita uhi.
Shiloh ah TOUPA akilak nawn a; TOUPA thu in Samuel kiang ah Shiloh a kilak lah ahi ngal a.
